title: 10th Sitting of first Session of 2025
summary: The 10th sitting of the first session of 2025 was a short one (10:31 to 11:01), the first after the start of Ramadan. Four written questions from the North Galolhu member to the Economic Development and Trade Minister about the Maldives-China free trade agreement were read out with the ministry's answers, and a new animal welfare bill had its first reading. The Foreign Relations Committee reported on two non-resident ambassador nominations, and the Majlis approved both without opposition (65-0 for Russia, 64-0 for Morocco).

items.title: Votes on the two non-resident ambassador appointments

speakers.name: Mohamed Ibrahim
positions: Asked whether and how much duty will be charged on tobacco and cigarettes imported from China under the free trade agreement.
Asked how much yearly import-duty revenue the FTA will cost and why the government did not publish the agreement.
Asked what duty applies to fish, squid and similar imports, and why the FTA rates differ from rates published by Customs.

speakers.name: Hassan Zareer
positions: Presented the committee report supporting the Russia and Morocco non-resident ambassador nominations after reviewing the nominees' documents.
Said non-resident ambassadors carry no extra pay or cost to the state and help the government cut spending while widening diplomatic ties.

decisions: Committee schedules and committee membership changes were announced; Ahmed Azaan Marzooq (Central Hithadhoo) replaces others on several committees.
The President's letter on the non-resident ambassador to the Philippines was sent to the Foreign Relations Committee.
The Animal Keeping and Animal Protection Bill had its first reading.
Lt Gen (Retd) Abdul Raheem Abdul Latheef approved as non-resident ambassador to the Russian Federation (65-0).
Ahmed Sareer approved as non-resident ambassador to the Kingdom of Morocco (64-0).
The next sitting was set for 4 March 2025 at 10:30.

votes.what: Non-resident ambassador to the Russian Federation, Lt Gen (Retd) Abdul Raheem Abdul Latheef
Non-resident ambassador to the Kingdom of Morocco, Ahmed Sareer
